# SHA256 of the tools CI downloads, pinned here on purpose.
#
# None of these publishes a checksum file or a SLSA attestation, so there is
# nothing upstream to verify against — Ghostty does sign its source tarballs
# with minisign, but not the macOS build CI actually runs. Recording the hashes
# here is what is left, and it is the stronger option anyway: a checksum
# fetched from the same release proves nothing, because whoever could replace
# the binary could replace that file too. These live in the repo, so if a
# published artifact ever changes, CI fails instead of running it.
#
# The workflow refuses to install a file it has no line for here, which means a
# new OS or architecture fails loudly rather than silently skipping the check.
#
# The Ghostty pin does double duty: it is also the parser the config is
# validated against. Adopt an option from a newer Ghostty and CI will correctly
# reject a key this version does not know, so bump it here and in ci.yml
# together.
#
# To update after bumping a version in ci.yml, download the artifacts and run
# `shasum -a 256` (macOS) or `sha256sum` (Linux) over them.

56affdd8de5527894dca6dc3d7e0a99a873b0f004d7aabc30ae407d3f48b0a79  shellcheck-v0.11.0.darwin.aarch64.tar.xz
8c3be12b05d5c177a04c29e3c78ce89ac86f1595681cab149b65b97c4e227198  shellcheck-v0.11.0.linux.x86_64.tar.xz
